integrity: The counterexample uses only the source's explicit Hamiltonian, root-conditioned partition-function definition, vertex count, parameter substitutions, and displayed Theorems 1 and 2. At zero couplings and zero field every Boltzmann weight is exactly one, so the finite-volume count and thermodynamic limit are exact state-counting identities.
scientific_limitations: The result is a counterexample to the printed partition-function and free-energy formulas, not a full corrected interacting free-energy theory.
No conclusion is drawn about the source's separate fixed-point phase-transition analysis.
A later same-author arbitrary-order free-energy article was identifiable but its full body was not accessible in this check; it remains an originality risk.
title: The self-similarity partition formula fails at the noninteracting Ising point
